recentItems.title: India-Bulgaria Ties Get Major Boost, EAM Jaishankar, FM Discuss IMEC, Trade & New Opportunities
recentItems.description:
India and Bulgaria are looking to deepen economic and strategic cooperation, with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar holding talks with Bulgarian Foreign Minister Velislava Petrova-Chamova. The discussions covered trade, investment, technology, security and connectivity, with a special focus on the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) and the India-EU Free Trade Agreement. Both sides also explored new opportunities for business exchanges and stronger bilateral engagement.

recentItems.description:
LIVE NOW: 'NOT MY WAR...', President Donald Trump shocks European allies and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky with a bold statement following his latest call with Russian President Vladimir Putin. While reaffirming support for peace efforts, Trump suggested Putin is ready to end the war, drawing praise from some and deep concern from NATO leaders.

recentItems.title: Times Now Amazing Indians Awards 2026
recentItems.description:
Meet two changemakers helping children stay in school and giving injured wildlife a second chance. This episode features Gopinath Pal, who set up schools and learning centres to support children from low-income families in the Sundarbans. He also helps parents build livelihoods closer to home through training in farming and fisheries, so their children can continue their education.
It also celebrates Colonel Dr. Nawaz Shariff, a winner in the Animal Welfare and Wildlife Conservation category. At People for Animals in Bengaluru, he and his team rescue, treat and rehabilitate injured wildlife so the animals can return to the wild. Both stories show what sustained care makes possible, from keeping a child in school to helping an injured animal recover the skills it needs to survive. #timesnow #english
